summary: Page 4 of the Monmouth Democrat (Freehold, NJ) includes a short item, 'Colored Newspaper Burned Out,' reporting that the Echo, a weekly Black newspaper published in Long Branch, NJ, was destroyed by a suspected incendiary fire that damaged its machinery and press room to the extent of several hundred dollars; the item notes the paper's first issue was edited by Rock & Howard. Rest of page is routine local township election-officer rosters, market reports, railroad timetables, and ads.

incidents.what: Fire, believed to be of incendiary origin, destroyed/burned out the Echo newspaper's press room and machinery in Long Branch, causing several hundred dollars in damage

connections: The Echo (Long Branch) is itself a Black-owned NJ publication of interest to the project
